        print(g, np.quantile(r.col(g),[0,.5,1])*1e12,'pA')
    axs[row,0].plot(B,R,lw=.7); axs[row,0].set(xlabel='B (T)',ylabel='signed Rxx (ohm)',title=f'Run {rid}, n={n:+.1f}e12, raw TSV')
    try:
        on=sdh_onset(R,B,r_full_scale=5000)
        print(on.summary()); results[str(rid)]={'onset':on.onset_b,'onset_freq':on.onset_freq,'summary':on.summary()}
        for tone in on.tones:
            axs[row,1].plot(tone.b_centers,tone.snr,label=f'{tone.freq:.1f} T')
        axs[row,1].axhline(5,color='k',ls=':'); axs[row,1].legend(fontsize=7)
        axs[row,1].set(xlabel='B (T)',ylabel='matched-filter SNR',yscale='log',title='Computed per-tone onset')
        for cut,deg in [(on.onset_b,3),(on.onset_b,5),(max(on.onset_b,1.5),3),(max(on.onset_b,1.5),5)]:
            f,sp=sdh_fft(R[:,None],B,b_range=(cut,10),bg_degree=deg,log=False,nfft=2048)

            print('FFT',cut,deg,[(round(f[i],2),round(sp[0,i]/sp.max(),3)) for i in pk])

    except SdhOnsetError as e:

fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(base/'hera_scratch/spot_checks.png',dpi=150); plt.show()

from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from hera.analysis import open_run, resolve_channels, plot_raw, sdh_onset, sdh_fft, summarize_run

for rid, n in [(6, 3.2), (7, -1.2)]:
    r = open_run(Path('data') / str(rid))
    print(summarize_run(r))
    plot_raw(r); plt.show()  # Native TSV, signed R and measured drain current FIRST.
    channels = {c.cid: c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
    I = r.col('sr0_X') / channels['sr0'].gain
    R = (r.col('sr1_X') / channels['sr1'].gain) / I
    B = r.col('magnet_field')
    print(f'Elapsed {np.ptp(r.col("time"))/60:.2f} min; R {R.min():.2f}..{R.max():.2f} ohm; I {I.min()*1e9:.3f}..{I.max()*1e9:.3f} nA')
    print(f'T_sample {r.col("T_sample").min():.3f}..{r.col("T_sample").max():.3f} K; peak |TG/BG current| {np.max(abs(r.col("k_2400_tg_curr")))*1e12:.1f}/{np.max(abs(r.col("k_2400_bg_curr")))*1e12:.1f} pA')
    on = sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=5000)
    print('Full-record onset (all flags retained):\n' + on.summary())
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4))
    if rid == 6:
        # Sensitivity check, not a replacement of the censored full-record result.
        # High-field MR is large; use the measured low-B record to isolate onset.
        for deg in (3, 5):
            local = sdh_onset(R, B, b_hi=4, bg_degree=deg, r_full_scale=5000)
            print(f'Low-field-only onset, B <= 4 T, degree {deg}:\n' + local.summary())
            for tone in local.tones:
                if 6 < tone.freq < 8:
                    ax[0].plot(tone.b_centers, tone.snr, 'o-', label=f'{tone.freq:.2f} T, degree {deg}')
        cuts = (1.03, 1.5, 2.0)
    else:
        cuts = (on.onset_b, 1.0, 1.5)
        for tone in on.tones[:3]:
            ax[0].plot(tone.b_centers, tone.snr, 'o-', label=f'{tone.freq:.2f} T')
    ax[0].axhline(5, color='k', ls=':'); ax[0].set(xlabel='B (T)', ylabel='matched-filter SNR', yscale='log'); ax[0].legend(fontsize=8)
    for cutoff in cuts:
        for deg in (3,5):
            f, spec = sdh_fft(R[:,None], B, b_range=(cutoff,10), bg_degree=deg, nfft=2048, log=False)
            band = (f > 3) & (f < 65)
            norm = spec[0,band].max()
            ax[1].plot(f, spec[0]/norm, label=f'B>={cutoff:.2f}, degree {deg}')
            pk, _ = find_peaks(spec[0]); pk = [p for p in pk if band[p]]
            pk = sorted(pk, key=lambda p:-spec[0,p])[:5]
            print(f'FFT cutoff={cutoff:.2f} degree={deg}: candidate peaks {[round(float(f[p]),2) for p in pk]} T')
    ax[1].axvline(abs(n)*10.33916924, color='k', ls=':', label='nominal g=4 F_L')
    ax[1].set(xlim=(0,65), ylim=(0,1.15), xlabel='F (T)', ylabel='FFT / max above 3 T')
    ax[1].legend(fontsize=7); fig.suptitle(f'Run {rid}: onset and FFT sensitivity, signed R; no B symmetrization available')
    fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

cat > hera_scratch/ana_spots.md <<'MD'
## Runs 6–7 — SdH evidence before the first fan

`sdh-spot-check`; governing investigation `tetralayer-stacking-fs-count`, steps 2–4. Run 6: electron n_A=+3.2×10¹² cm⁻², D_A≈0, 0→10 T; run 7: hole n_A=−1.2×10¹², D_A≈0, 10→0.3 T. Both completed, current remains 9.81–9.94 nA, sample 1.165–1.292 K, |gate current|≤216 pA, and |Rxx|<590 Ω against 5 kΩ full scale. The hardwired B_1−B_2 channel remains live. Raw signed resistance and current precede the derived plots below; negative R values are retained, not rectified or log-clipped.

**Provisional channel verdict: B_1−B_2 — uninformative for stacking so far.** Electron-side candidate components around 7, 22, and 29–30 T survive the tested high-field FFT windows, with additional ≈14 T content and higher harmonics. Integer ratios alone cannot label pockets; the global scale, Luttinger partition, harmonic screen, sum-tone origin and ABAB/trilayer dual overlay remain pending density dependence. Hole-side content is strong but window-sensitive (roughly 5–7 and 12 T), in the near-CNP regime where templates are poorly separated. Neither trace was measured at negative B, so even-in-B separation is unavailable. Two CNP ridges in run 5 are a spatial-doping confound, not established stacking domains; this single contact pair cannot independently resolve those regions.

**Onset fork, retained:** full-record electron `sdh_onset` gives a censored 0.30 T edge. The high-field MR tail biases the low-frequency background: restricting the existing trace to 0.3–4 T gives a 6.7 T candidate onset ≈1.03–1.04 T, marginal for degree 3 and robust for degree 5; the 22 T component starts ≈1.38 T in both. This is not evidence of oscillations down to 0.3 T. The fan's low-edge choice must carry this extraction sensitivity explicitly; frequencies near 7 T need reproduction on the uniform-1/B grid and a shared-density comparison. The hole headline onset is 0.714 T. Absolute density remains a geometry prior (~10–15%); D≈0 is inferred from the run-5 ridge-resistance symmetry, with finite residual-D uncertainty.

Timing measured from TSV: run 6 120.31 min, run 7 95.63 min. After subtracting the fixed 438 s/T ramp floor, the median field-point overhead is 3.08/3.07 s. Run 5 at NPLC=1 has 1.098 s median and 1.116 s 90th-percentile point time at 1 s dwell; its 5.77 s row boundary includes 3 s slow delay and the 1.3 V TG flyback. These session measurements, not inherited fan rates, price the next cell.
MD

# landau-fan-vti: electron D~0 fan; run-5 calibration, run-6 shared-density anchor.
# Read-only preconditions before any instrument write.
import numpy as np
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD
from hera.analysis import field_invB

def _fan_limits(p):
    return (float(p.vals._min_value), float(p.vals._max_value))
for _name, _p, _expected in [
    ('TG', k_2400_tg.volt, (-0.3, 1.0)), ('BG', k_2400_bg.volt, (-1.3, 2.0)),
    ('Si', dc205.smart_voltage, (-25.0, 25.0)), ('Si raw', dc205.voltage, (-25.0, 25.0)),
    ('field', magnet.field, (-10.0, 10.0)),
    ('sample setpoint', heater.sample_setpoint, (0.0, 100.0)),
    ('vaporizer setpoint', heater.vaporizer_setpoint, (0.0, 100.0))]:
    _actual = _fan_limits(_p)
    print(f'{_name}: expected validator {_expected}; actual {_actual}')
    assert _actual == _expected, f'SAFETIES mismatch: {_name}'
assert B_SESSION_CAP == 10.0 and T_SESSION_CAP == 100.0
assert k_tg is k_2400_tg and k_bg is k_2400_bg and k_si is dc205.smart_voltage
for _name in ('T_sample', 'T_vaporizer'):
    assert_thermometry_live(_name, VTI.temp_logfile_candidates[_name], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_Ts, _Tv, _B0, _Si = T_sample(), T_vaporizer(), magnet.field(), k_si()
_hr = (heater.sample_range(), heater.vaporizer_range())
_ps = (magnet.persistent_switch_on(), magnet.output_enabled())
print(f'Expected base 1.0..1.5 K, vaporizer <1.6 K, B~0 (+/-0.02 T), Si=0 (+/-0.01 V), heaters off, PS/output on; actual {_Ts}, {_Tv}, {_B0}, {_Si}, {_hr}, {_ps}')
assert 1.0 <= _Ts <= 1.5 and 0 < _Tv < 1.6 and abs(_Tv-_Ts) < 0.6
assert abs(_B0) < 0.02 and abs(_Si) < 0.01 and _hr == (0,0) and all(_ps)
print('Expected fixed wiring T_0 -> B_3, sr1 B_1-B_2; actual', WIRING)
assert WIRING == {'source':'T_0','drain':'B_3','sr1+':'B_1','sr1-':'B_2', 'sr2+':'n.c.','sr2-':'n.c.','sr3+':'n.c.','sr3-':'n.c.'}
assert 'mux' not in globals()
print('Expected Si range/output/rate 2/1/0.5; actual',dc205.voltage_range(),dc205.output(),dc205.ramp_rate)
assert dc205.voltage_range() == 2 and dc205.output() == 1 and dc205.ramp_rate == 0.5
print('Expected TG/BG step 0.005 V, NPLC 1; actual',k_tg.volt.step,k_bg.volt.step,k_tg.nplci(),k_bg.nplci())
assert k_tg.volt.step == 0.005 and k_bg.volt.step == 0.005
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1
_drive, _freq = sr1.amplitude(), sr1.frequency()
print('Expected drive 1 V, 13.777 Hz; actual',_drive,_freq)
assert abs(_drive-1.0) < 1e-6 and abs(_freq-13.777) < 0.01
for _li in (sr0,sr1):
    _tau, _slope = _li.time_constant(), _li.filter_slope()
    print(f'{_li.name}: expected tau 0.3 s, slope 24 dB/oct; actual {_tau}, {_slope}')
    assert _tau == 0.3 and _slope == 24
assert meas_config['sr0_gain'] == -1e6 and meas_config['bias_resistor'] == 100e6 and meas_config['bias_channel'] == 'sr1'
print('Expected sr0 sensitivity 0.02 V; actual',sr0.sensitivity())
assert sr0.sensitivity() == 0.02

CAL_FAN = dict(c_tg=2.796e-3, c_bg=2.161e-3, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
B_LO, B_HI = 1.0309096913954, 7.05
# Full nominal Luttinger frequency <=33.09 T; observed harmonic candidates extend to 130 T.
N_B = int(np.ceil((1/B_LO-1/B_HI)*2*130.0))+1
# Include +20% density-scale allowance in the density-axis ray-Nyquist floor.
N_N = int(np.ceil((3.2-2.8)*1.2/(B_LO/10.33916924/2)))+1
ns_fan = np.linspace(2.8,3.2,N_N)
B_fan = field_invB(B_LO,B_HI,N_B)
Vt_fan,Vb_fan = calc_gate_voltages(ns_fan,np.zeros_like(ns_fan),**CAL_FAN)
for _p,_vec in ((k_tg.volt,Vt_fan),(k_bg.volt,Vb_fan),(magnet.field,B_fan)):

assert np.allclose(_nr,ns_fan) and np.max(abs(_Dr)) < 1e-10
assert np.max(abs(np.diff(1/B_fan))) <= 1/(2*130)
assert 1.2*np.max(np.diff(ns_fan)) <= B_LO/10.33916924/2
print(f'Grid {N_B} x {N_N} = {N_B*N_N}; B {B_LO:.6f}->{B_HI:.2f} T; n_A 2.8..3.2e12, D_A~0; TG {Vt_fan.min():.5f}..{Vt_fan.max():.5f}, BG {Vb_fan.min():.5f}..{Vb_fan.max():.5f} V')

# Fixed range, unchanged excitation/filter/pacing. All elapsed waits are interruptible.
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)

mc_fan = dict(meas_config)
mc_fan.update({'Si (V)':_Si,'sample_temperature:':_Ts,'sr1_gain':1.0,
              'gate_calibration':CAL_FAN,'fan_density_1e12_cm2':ns_fan.tolist(),
              'comments':'electron D_A~0, n_A 2.8..3.2e12, B 1.0309097->7.05 T uniform 1/B; run-6 anchor; onset sensitivity remains a caveat',
              'lockin_tau_s':0.3,'lockin_slope_db_oct':24,'settling_s':3.0})
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc_fan)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment(f'n_A=+2.8..+3.2e12 cm^-2 ({N_N} pts); D_A=0 V/nm; B={B_LO:.7f}->7.05 T ({N_B} rows uniform 1/B); Si=0 V; 10 nA; sr1=50 uV; fast dwell=3 s=10 tau; run-5 calibration; run-6 shared n=3.2 anchor; positive B only')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt,float(Vb_fan[0])); s.ramp(k_tg.volt,float(Vt_fan[0]))
interruptible_sleep(3)
# Position from measured ~0: 1.031 T * 7.3 min/T = 7.53 min + driver's 3 s settle.
magnet.field(B_LO)
print('Positioned field: expected',B_LO,'actual',magnet.field())
assert abs(magnet.field()-B_LO) < 0.02

# Layout: time,B_set,Vtg,Vbg,Ts,Tv,Itg,Ibg,X0,P0,X1,P1,B_read.
for _p in (T_sample,T_vaporizer,k_tg.curr,k_bg.curr,sr0.X,sr0.P,sr1.X,sr1.P,magnet.field):
    s.fp(_p)
    s.plot('time',_p)  # Every recorded value is visible, including phase/temperature/readback.
_fan_stop = []
_fan_row = [None]
def _fan_guard(station,data):
    _b = float(data[1])
    if _fan_row[0] != _b:
        for _name in ('T_sample','T_vaporizer'):
            try:
                assert_thermometry_live(_name,VTI.temp_logfile_candidates[_name],max_age=15,max_period=12)
            except Exception as _err:
                _fan_stop.append(f'thermometry freshness: {_err}')
        _fan_row[0] = _b
    if not np.all(np.isfinite(np.asarray(data,dtype=float))): _fan_stop.append('nonfinite readback')
    if max(abs(data[6]),abs(data[7])) > 1e-9: _fan_stop.append('gate leakage >1 nA')
    if not (1.0 <= data[4] <= 1.5 and 0 < data[5] < 1.6): _fan_stop.append('off base temperature')
    if abs(data[10]) >= 0.9*50e-6 or abs(data[8]) >= 0.9*0.02: _fan_stop.append('lock-in near full scale')
    if not 8e-9 <= data[8]/-1e6 <= 12e-9: _fan_stop.append('drain current outside 8..12 nA')
    if abs(data[12]-_b) > 0.02: _fan_stop.append('field readback mismatch')
    if _fan_stop:
        print('FAN STOP:',_fan_stop)
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(_fan_guard,())
_fan_result = s.multimegasweep([magnet.field],[B_fan],[k_tg.volt,k_bg.volt],[Vt_fan,Vb_fan],slow_delay=1,fast_delay=3)
print('Fan file_id',_fan_result.id,'interrupted',_fan_result.metadata.get('interrupted',False),'guards',_fan_stop)
# Hold endpoint deliberately; no automatic field retraverse or close-out.
print('Actual endpoint B,TG,BG,Si,Ts,Tv:',magnet.field(),k_tg.volt(),k_bg.volt(),k_si(),T_sample(),T_vaporizer())

## HERA — first D≈0 electron Landau fan for the stacking investigation

`landau-fan-vti` (base `landau-fan`), in-arc under `tetralayer-stacking-fs-count` steps 2–5. Gates A/B remain green in the same kernel: setup/SAFETIES measure cells 2–27, VERIFY 32, operator handoff readback 44 and binding probe 46; Gate C passed in runs 0–3 (ana 10–11). Runs 6–7 are now analyzed raw-first in ana 14–15. Choose the electron side because the available high density separates the model templates and reproduces run 6 at n_A=3.2; the hole range stops near −1.27 and its close low-density pair is harder to interpret. The committed calibration is the run-5 ratio c_bg/c_tg≈0.773, geometry-prior absolute scale, n_offset=−0.0894×10¹², D_offset=−0.013 V/nm; use the identical rounded coefficients used for run 6 so the shared-density gate settings match.

**Claim and uncertainty.** This is a narrow density-dependence and sampling-reproduction measurement on the hardwired B_1−B_2 channel, not a preassigned ABAB/ABCA verdict. Run 6 has candidate ≈7, 22, 29–30 T components and higher harmonics; require a global-scale fit to the whole set, Luttinger-aware harmonic screening, ABAB and trilayer dual overlays, and the sum-tone origin audit before a call. The second CNP ridge does not establish a second stacking domain. Only positive B is measured; odd-in-B contamination and unresolved spatial contributions remain hedges.

**Onset is an extraction fork.** The full 0.3–10 T polynomial analysis returns a censored 0.30 T edge, while the large high-field MR contaminates the low-frequency background. On the existing low-field-only 0.3–4 T record, `sdh_onset(..., b_hi=4, bg_degree=5, r_full_scale=5000)` gives **1.0309097 T**, carried by the ≈6.7 T component; degree 3 gives that component 1.04 T but marks it marginal, with the 22 T headline at 1.38 T. This fan uses the measured local onset provisionally, not the censored full-record edge as a physical onset. It cannot establish whether useful oscillations exist below 1.03 T. Reproduction at n=3.2 and a post-fan per-column onset audit are required; if the useful window starts higher, recompute resolution and downgrade the call, never count sub-onset rows as signal. A lower-field extension remains the deciding measurement for this onset fork.

**Binding design math (nominal run-5 density scale).** Direct `fs_count_b0.abab_fs(n*1e16)` gives the ABAB pair **6.038/22.914 T at n=2.8**, and **7.306/25.783 T at n=3.2**; ABCA F_L is **28.950→33.085 T**. The inverse-field record is **0.828173 T⁻¹**, δF=**1.2075 T**: the lowest-density partner gets **5.0004 periods**, and the ≥6.038 T heavy-ABAB/ABCA split exceeds 2δF=2.415 T. Solving the five-period condition at n=2.8 gives B_max≥7.0465 T; use 7.05 T, without paying the additional 21.5 min bare traverse to 10 T. This five-period statement is nominal, not guaranteed over the density-scale prior or a later-onset column; fit the scale globally and re-evaluate it in the read.

**Both-axis Nyquist and cost floor.** Uniform 1/B: **217 rows**, Δ(1/B)=**0.0038341 T⁻¹**, Nyquist **130.41 T**. This clears the nominal F_L≤33.09 T, its +20% scale allowance and the measured higher-frequency candidates up to ≈130 T from run 6; those candidates need not be pockets, but allowing them to alias into the low-tone band would invalidate the read. Density: **11 points**, Δn=**0.04×10¹² cm⁻²**; even with +20% scale, 0.048 is below the lowest-field ray-Nyquist bound B_lo/(2×10.339)=**0.04985×10¹²**. Total **2,387 points**. Gate vectors round-trip to D=0: TG **0.8690→0.9836 V**, BG **1.0178→1.1661 V**, Si stays 0 V. No clamping and no validator, gate pacing, field-cap or temperature-cap changes.

**Settling and dynamic range.** Preserve 10 nA, τ=0.3 s and 24 dB/oct; **fast_delay=3 s=10τ**, slow_delay=1 s plus the driver's 3 s field settle. Set sr1 to the spot-check's **50 µV (5 kΩ nominal full scale)**, not the 2 µV restored at handoff; sr0 remains 20 mV. Run 6 peaks at 530 Ω over the larger 0–10 T range; scaling by 3.2/2.8 and a further factor 3 gives a conservative heuristic 1.82 kΩ corner budget, below full scale. This is a headroom estimate, not measured low-density MR; abort at 90% range. Record and plot both temperatures, both gate currents, both wired lock-ins' X and phase, and actual field; n.c. sr2/sr3 are not measured.

**Price and coverage trade.** Run 5 measured 1.098 s median / 1.116 s p90 per point with 1 s dwell and NPLC=1. Budget **3.2 s/point** here for 3 s dwell, paired-gate writes and added readbacks: **127.3 min** acquisition. Total 0→7.05 T travel is **7.05×7.3=51.5 min**, including **7.53 min positioning** to the first row; runs 6/7 measured ≈3.08 s overhead per field point, so budget that per row plus 1 s slow delay and ≈0.5 s paired-gate flyback (**16.6 min**). Subtotal ≈195 min; allow ≈15% for overhead variation and preflight → headline rounded to 3 h 50 min. The full accessible D=0 gate line (−1.27→+3.27) at the same conservative sampling would require about 111 density points and >22 h, while its low-density partner would still fail the period requirement. We exclude that region and the hole side explicitly. Even n=2.7 needs B≈10.41 T for five nominal partner periods at this onset, outside the committed 10 T cap. The selected 0.4×10¹² span limits branch-trajectory discrimination; a calibrated cannot-tell remains an acceptable outcome.

**Checkpoints and endpoint.** Inspect the first three landed rows (roughly 10–12 min including positioning) for leakage, clipping, dead channels, current and field tracking. Then inspect every ~25 rows / 20 min; automatic per-point guards stop on >1 nA gate current, clipping, loss of current, off-base temperature, nonfinite data or >20 mT field mismatch; each row checks thermometry freshness (15 s age, 12 s cadence). At B≈3 T (about row 167), compare the n=3.2 column with run 6 over the same field window and attempt the first resolution-qualified FFT; abandon if adequate data cannot reproduce its oscillations or if acquisition quality fails. Keep the live `hera-watch` digest armed throughout. On normal completion, hold **7.05 T and the n=3.2 gates** for analysis and a possible downward follow-up; no unrequested retraverse or state0 replay. On a stop, re-read actual state and notify Zack; VTI kernel interrupt does **not** stop a supply ramp, so an in-progress magnet ramp requires operator intervention at the instrument. Close-out remains the brief's separate return-to-initial question.
